scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyaan
other_conditions: Only one eligible person per household where none of the family members is digitally literate will be considered

Priority given to non‑smartphone users, Antyodaya households, college drop‑outs, participants of the adult literacy mission, and digitally illiterate school students (class 9‑12) where ICT training is unavailable
Preference given to women, differently‑abled persons, and minorities
benefits_summary: Provides digital literacy training (≈20 hours) to rural residents, enabling them to use computers, the internet, and digital payment services.
